title: Yin-Ya NDE 16127
content: Zhi Hu forum (Posted on 12-24-2021) It was a very serene feeling that I clearly perceived all my organs ceased function gradually, it started from my feet then one by one up to the lung; no pain. I worried about whether I would experience difficulty breathing when it reached my chest, but it turned out to be pain free. After all the organs were inoperative, I lay flat, rising and floating vertically. At that moment, my only thought was that I had to tell my family I was dead. A chubby woman in a medieval white robe and wearing a white sleeping hat with fungus shaped brim greeted me with a smile. Slowly I flew into a dark space, tilted upward in a steady way, and there was a gleaming light very far away. On the way, there was a set of 3-dimensional shapes that composed of light. Although it was light, I knew that it is some sort of material which is rather a law of the universe. Its appearance is similar to a treble clef, and there is a long, lit arm reaching out from the right side and a three-dimensional spiral line underneath it, which became smaller progressively. Additionally, there were some other complicated structures in the middle that I could not remember. It was a very, very comfortable feeling. Later I thought about my kids being too young so that I have to go back. Instantly I woke up. I was 37 years old then. I am no longer afraid of death ever since, however I cherish every day now. I tried my best to learn as much as I can and work hard effectively that I have no time to waste, not bothered to maintain complex relationships, and not willing to tell any lies. As time went by I remember more of my experience that I had acute asthma which caused me to stop breathing temporarily. I took some Chinese herbal medicine and recovered. My health becomes much better, emotions are stable, and personality is calmer afterward.

environment.environment_other_detail: Dark space; a gleaming light very far away; a set of 3-dimensional shapes composed of light, perceived as material/a universal law (treble-clef-like with a long lit arm and a 3D spiral line underneath).

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Acute asthma; stopped breathing temporarily (later recalled).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Non-tunnel dark-space passage with distant gleaming light; encounter with a smiling robed woman; encounter with complex 3D light-structures perceived as universal law/material.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE (floating up) then greeted by a robed woman, then movement into dark space toward distant light; return occurred after thinking about children.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Detailed perception of a 3-dimensional light structure interpreted as "some sort of material" / "a law of the universe," treble-clef-like with a long lit arm and a 3D spiral line underneath.

"It was a very, very comfortable feeling." "Later I thought about my kids being too young so that I have to go back. Instantly I woke up."
